name: Cabezón de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cabezón de la Sierra (a horse, a castle and stars on red).
history: Municipal flag of Cabezón de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cabezón de la Sierra arms — horse, castle and stars
